set.body: Independent Astra-high review of frozen main 536ee863 found a P3: OverlaySelections.scala57 pre-scales DashPx by deviceScale, while pinned Intaglio DashPattern defaults to layout pixels and applies ppi/96 during lowering. Exact pinned-jar Scala/SVG probe: 1x width3 dash6/3; 2x width6 dash24/12, expected dash12/6. Remove the extra scaling (or declare DevicePixel explicitly) and assert exact 1x/2x dash values in OverlaySelectionsSuite. Reproduction: /private/tmp/eyes4s-followups-dash-probe/DashProbe.scala. No other actionable followups-batch findings; no sbt/FX rerun during review.
